trickyParts: secretsd identifies a tokenless caller by isatty(0) + readlink /proc/self/fd/0, so runSecretsGet spawns with stdio [inherit, pipe, pipe]; the config.test.ts human-tier test asserts the fake saw the test process's own fd 0 and the live boot's call log shows /dev/pts/100 (the pane's tty) for all four calls.

Only SECRETSD_SESSION_TOKEN_FILE is dropped from the secrets children's env, not all SECRETSD_*: SECRETSD_SOCK is the broker socket override (crates/proto/src/client.rs from_environment) and dropping it would break the client; the spec's parenthetical 'and any other SECRETSD_* session variable' has no other member today.
Bun's spawnSync returns result.error with code ENOENT for a missing executable (no synchronous throw), so the plan's straight-line error mapping stands.

Boot's tokenManager.getToken('implement', owner) needs a real App key before the listening lines, so the live boot's fake secrets fabricated only the tier status and delegated `--value` to the real binary (a tokenless agent-tier read works from any stdin); no PEM ever reached a log.

Live boot from a Legion pane must also scrub LEGION_OMP_PATH: the inherited value names the outer daemon's custom omp build (omp-18.1.15-sami.9bff2014-rpcfix) whose pi_natives addon is out of sync (`does not expose the version sentinel __piNativesV18_1_15`), so the OMP probe fails definitively at the launch hold; the pinned default (18.1.18-sami.20260912-104423) boots. Environment fact, not a code issue.
